{{Quote|I tell you, Master, this is the ''dullest'' duty I've ever had. Shepherding farm animals&mdash;smelly, noisy farm animals&mdash;to terraformed planets is the ''worst''!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Ahsoka's Ark">{{TCWComicCite|6.36|Ahsoka's Ark}}</ref>}}
This '''Unidentified terraformed world''' was an inhabited astronomical object [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

During this period. it had successfully petitioned the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for the receival of farm animals to populate it.
